title: rubus asper subvar. grandifoliolatus
intro: Rubus asper subvar. grandifoliolatus, commonly known as the Himalayan raspberry or Himalayan bramble, is a type of flowering plant in the rose family that is native to the Himalayan region. This plant is known for its antioxidant properties and has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Rubus asper subvar. grandifoliolatus include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to reduce pain and inflammation, as well as its potential to lower blood pressure and cholesterol levels. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-cancer properties.
